column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/hoist_cond_panic_stage.onsa tests=11 evaluated=11 unavailable=0 skipped=0 waiting=0
@ a panic under a condition of block that holds is a panic of the block stage, a call of 0 frames too
process 0 params n=0 frames=0 in x=[]
@ the same flow does not panic where the condition does not hold
process 0 params n=3 frames=0 in x=[]
render hoist_cond_panic_stage.block_condition sr=0x41000000 params n=3 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ a panic under a condition of init that holds is a panic of init
@ the same flow with a = 2 gives x
render hoist_cond_panic_stage.init_condition sr=0x41000000 cfg a=2 in x=[0x40400000]
@ a panic under a condition of sample is a panic of the frame that takes the branch
@ a panic under a condition of sample under a condition of block that holds is evaluated by the frame
process 0 params n=1 frames=0 in x=[]
render hoist_cond_panic_stage.block_outside_sample_inside sr=0x41000000 params n=0 in x=[0xbf800000]
render hoist_cond_panic_stage.block_outside_sample_inside sr=0x41000000 params n=1 in x=[0xbf800000]
@ the else branch with a panic is taken by the block stage where the condition does not hold
process 0 params n=2 frames=0 in x=[]
process 0 params n=0 frames=0 in x=[]
@ a panic in a let under a condition of block that holds is a panic of the block stage
process 0 params n=1 frames=0 in x=[]
render hoist_cond_panic_stage.in_a_let sr=0x41000000 params n=1 in x=[0x3f800000]
process 0 params n=0 frames=0 in x=[]
@ a panic in an arm is a panic of the block stage where the pattern matches
render hoist_cond_panic_stage.match_arm sr=0x41000000 params o=#1(0x40000000) in x=[0x40400000]
process 0 params o=#1(0x40000000) frames=0 in x=[]
process 0 params o=#0() frames=0 in x=[]
@ a condition of init and a condition of block: the first panic is the init's, the second the block's
process 0 params n=1 frames=0 in x=[]
render hoist_cond_panic_stage.init_then_block sr=0x41000000 cfg a=1 params n=1 in x=[0x40400000]
process 0 params n=0 frames=0 in x=[]
